body.name: v1.124.0
body.description:
## Changelog   
### ✨ Features   
* **feat(artifact-registry):** add --yarn to login ([4f0d9e7a](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/4f0d9e7a)) by Hamza Hassanain<!--community-->   
* **feat(auth):** add --setup-git-credential-helper to glab auth login ([5044c7ca](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/5044c7ca)) by Yarra Vivek<!--community-->   
* **feat(ci):** navigate ci view modals with hjkl ([c636c27e](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/c636c27e)) by Radek Antoniuk<!--community-->   
* **feat(df):** add cargo wrapper command behind the firewall proxy ([20ecaf16](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/20ecaf16)) by Michael Eddington<!--team-->   
* **feat(df):** add nuget proxy matcher ([1f766d07](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/1f766d07)) by Michael Eddington<!--team-->   
* **feat(govern):** remove hooks with setup --uninstall ([8aff5df9](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/8aff5df9)) by Jean van der Walt<!--team-->   
* **feat(govern):** report fallback sync version drift in doctor ([5639350a](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/5639350a)) by Jean van der Walt<!--team-->   
* **feat(issue):** add --internal flag to issue and incident note commands ([bb1ca114](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/bb1ca114)) by Jay McCure<!--team-->   
* **feat(issue):** add date filters to issue list ([d5034f13](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/d5034f13)) by Hamza Hassanain<!--community-->   
* **feat(issue):** filter lists by assignment status ([e515a629](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/e515a629)) by Yarra Vivek<!--community-->   
* **feat(mcp):** deprecate glab mcp serve ([9d587016](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/9d587016)) by Jay McCure<!--team-->   
* **feat(mr):** add --worktree flag to mr checkout ([bb463eb9](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/bb463eb9)) by Jeston Singh<!--community-->   
* **feat(mr):** filter update branch lookup by state ([4e7dc511](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/4e7dc511)) by Yarra Vivek<!--community-->   
* **feat(mr):** respect --push=false with --fill ([fe01ead1](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/fe01ead1)) by José M. Requena Plens<!--community-->   
* **feat(template):** accept file paths for --template ([28ed99dc](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/28ed99dc)) by Radek Antoniuk<!--community-->   
* **feat(variable):** add --inherited to look up parent groups ([2bf188e7](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/2bf188e7)) by Yarra Vivek<!--community-->   
* **feat:** package delete via --name ([0da2fd79](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/0da2fd79)) by Jack<!--community-->   
* **feat:** show time tracking stats in issue view and mr view ([7a6a8c39](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/7a6a8c39)) by Giannis Kepas<!--community-->   
* **feat:** support setting work item iteration id ([2f19867b](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/2f19867b)) by BoxBoxJason<!--community-->   
### 🐛 Bug Fixes   
* **fix(alias):** pass alias arguments through unchanged ([a1704a99](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/a1704a99)) by José M. Requena Plens<!--community-->   
* **fix(auth):** fail clearly on a missing keyring token ([509e14e8](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/509e14e8)) by Hamza Hassanain<!--community-->   
* **fix(binarymgr):** write install progress to stderr ([eeed2f76](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/eeed2f76)) by Dmitry Gruzd<!--team-->   
* **fix(checkout):** fetch through the matched remote so the tracking ref is created ([a220667c](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/a220667c)) by braineo<!--community-->   
* **fix(ci):** stop tracing a skipped job ([639607b2](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/639607b2)) by José M. Requena Plens<!--community-->   
* fix(cluster graph): exit on Ctrl+C and SIGTERM ([ba4f1017](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/ba4f1017)) by Radek Antoniuk<!--community-->   
* **fix(cluster):** write kubeconfig to real home in snap ([d1abaf7d](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/d1abaf7d)) by Radek Antoniuk<!--community-->   
* **fix(config):** skip the read-permission check for shared config files ([31b4143a](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/31b4143a)) by ANBUCHELVAN GANESAN CSE<!--community-->   
* **fix(govern):** keep audit event batches within GitLab's limits ([06b1073a](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/06b1073a)) by Jean van der Walt<!--team-->   
* **fix(govern):** send the sync_type of the path that syncs the session ([cee363d3](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/cee363d3)) by Jean van der Walt<!--team-->   
* **fix(installer):** install x86_64 build in Program Files ([bf26bbe6](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/bf26bbe6)) by Radek Antoniuk<!--community-->   
* **fix(issue):** keep --confidential and --iteration with --group ([e74199fd](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/e74199fd)) by José M. Requena Plens<!--community-->   
* **fix(mcp):** link the deprecation feedback issue in the warning ([cb9a3c85](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/cb9a3c85)) by Jay McCure<!--team-->   
* fix(mr note): require merge request with --repo for resolve and reopen ([b17cc1eb](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/b17cc1eb)) by Dmitry Gruzd<!--team-->   
* **fix(mr):** don't add a second Draft: prefix in mr create ([eeab6dbc](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/eeab6dbc)) by Andrew Dunn<!--team-->   
* **fix(mr):** handle nil references in mr list ([cc936bec](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/cc936bec)) by Hamza Hassanain<!--community-->   
* **fix(mr):** preserve order for single-user filters ([94c2eefd](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/94c2eefd)) by wushuwen<!--community-->   
* **fix(packages):** verify the checksum of the newest file with the same name ([28cd7b06](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/28cd7b06)) by José M. Requena Plens<!--community-->   
* **fix(release):** close the release notes directory handle ([870f8a7d](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/870f8a7d)) by Yarra Vivek<!--community-->   
* **fix(release):** download Markdown upload assets through the API ([e83bbf79](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/e83bbf79)) by Yarra Vivek<!--community-->   
* **fix(release):** explain catalog semantic version errors ([7a485266](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/7a485266)) by Yarra Vivek<!--community-->   
* **fix(repo):** send topics instead of deprecated tag_list ([3f70ffcb](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/3f70ffcb)) by Anish Kumar<!--community-->   
* **fix(schedule):** show the real total in the list header ([7a2abceb](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/7a2abceb)) by unstable-code<!--community-->   
* **fix(stack):** track the current stack per worktree ([e5a8150f](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/e5a8150f)) by Radek Antoniuk<!--community-->   
* **fix(variable):** only update attributes passed to variable update ([aa735432](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/aa735432)) by Leroy Korterink<!--community-->   
* **fix:** skip telemetry for shell completion requests ([3fb7e8d3](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/3fb7e8d3)) by LY<!--community-->   
### 📝 Documentation   
* **docs(orbit):** point agents to the Orbit skill in help ([8fe3673c](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/8fe3673c)) by Dmitry Gruzd<!--team-->   
### 🔧 Maintenance   
* **chore:** move GitLab CLI to the Developer Clients group ([8003e52b](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/8003e52b)) by Kai Armstrong<!--team-->   
* **ci(release):** render Slack release notes as markdown ([d51c4cc5](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/d51c4cc5)) by Jay McCure<!--team-->   
* **ci(snap):** allow edge snap release to fail pending store review ([f48474a7](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/f48474a7)) by Jay McCure<!--team-->   
* **ci:** fetch docs review app tokens only in canonical pipelines ([3477f045](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/3477f045)) by Marcel Amirault<!--team-->   
* **ci:** retry snapcraft release jobs on script failure ([95073f1a](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/95073f1a)) by Jay McCure<!--team-->   
* **refactor(artifact-registry):** drive login tool flags from writers table ([782ceba3](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/782ceba3)) by Yarra Vivek<!--community-->   
* refactor(mr view): correct commentPageNujmber typo to commentPageNumber ([a33e8f51](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/a33e8f51)) by sai krishna chowdary<!--community-->   
* **refactor(oauth2):** move credential merge to oauth2 ([cadbd956](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/cadbd956)) by Hamza Hassanain<!--community-->   
### 📦 Dependencies   
* **chore(deps):** migrate D2 to github.com/d2lang/d2 v0.9.0 ([9d32d0fb](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/9d32d0fb)) by Radek Antoniuk<!--community-->   
* **chore(deps):** update module charm.land/bubbletea/v2 to v2.1.0 ([95641f4f](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/95641f4f)) by GitLab Dependency Bot<!--team-->   
* **chore(deps):** update module github.com/docker/cli to v29.9.0+incompatible ([01745075](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/01745075)) by GitLab Dependency Bot<!--team-->   
* **chore(deps):** update module github.com/docker/docker-credential-helpers to v0.9.10 ([fab36a75](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/fab36a75)) by GitLab Dependency Bot<!--team-->   
* **chore(deps):** update module github.com/mattn/go-colorable to v0.1.16 ([ce0ff508](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/ce0ff508)) by GitLab Dependency Bot<!--team-->   
* **chore(deps):** update module github.com/mattn/go-runewidth to v0.0.31 ([ee709d9b](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/ee709d9b)) by GitLab Dependency Bot<!--team-->   
* **chore(deps):** update module gitlab.com/gitlab-org/api/client-go/v3 to v3.21.0 ([f08df936](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/f08df936)) by GitLab Dependency Bot<!--team-->   
* **chore(deps):** update module gitlab.com/gitlab-org/api/client-go/v3 to v3.22.0 ([d1e6c1cb](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/d1e6c1cb)) by GitLab Dependency Bot<!--team-->   
* **chore(deps):** update module gitlab.com/gitlab-org/api/client-go/v3 to v3.23.0 ([838ee8a8](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/838ee8a8)) by GitLab Dependency Bot<!--team-->   
* **chore(deps):** update module gitlab.com/gitlab-org/api/client-go/v3 to v3.25.0 ([4222bb30](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/4222bb30)) by Jay McCure<!--team-->   
* **chore(deps):** update module golang.org/x/crypto to v0.58.0 ([7fae9b8f](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/7fae9b8f)) by GitLab Dependency Bot<!--team-->   
* **chore(deps):** update module golang.org/x/sys to v0.49.0 ([364c486a](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/364c486a)) by GitLab Dependency Bot<!--team-->   
### 🔀 Others   
* **perf(api):** keep up to 25 idle connections per host ([74931758](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/74931758)) by Mikhail Mazurskiy<!--team-->   
* **perf(api):** reuse connections across API clients ([9c9cfb84](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/9c9cfb84)) by Mikhail Mazurskiy<!--team-->   
* **perf(release):** upload release assets in parallel ([6098a411](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/6098a411)) by Radek Antoniuk<!--community-->
